items.titolo: Top AI tech executives promise to ‘self-police’ AI development
items.descrizione: The heads of the biggest AI labs — Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Nvidia — went to Washington and signed the 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities,' promising to develop their own models safely.
